title: Income Criteria for Blue and Orange CHAS Cards in View of Inflation
what_it_is: Income Criteria for Blue and Orange CHAS Cards in View of Inflation

sections.label: CHAS subsidy and appeals
sections.summary: CHAS subsidy levels and income criteria were last reviewed in 2019, and MOH received around 14,000 appeals in the last two years, with three in four upgraded.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Both the Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) subsidy levels and income criteria were last reviewed in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: From early next year, CHAS cardholders can benefit from the Healthier SG Chronic Tier, if they enrol with a Healthier SG general practitioner (GP) clinic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In the last two years, MOH has received around 14,000 appeals for changes of CHAS card status.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Three in four managed to upgrade their cards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH considers all appeals on a case-by-case basis to review applicants’ means and circumstances, beyond just applying eligibility criteria of per capita household income or the annual value of their homes.

sections.label: Inflation index subsidy suggestion
sections.summary: MOH says it regularly reviews income criteria and will take into account the suggestion to incorporate an inflation index into CHAS subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: The last supplementary question is, would MOH consider incorporating an inflation index into the amount of subsidies that each CHAS card would give to the residents, so that again, it would always move in tandem with inflation, and you would not have to review every three or four years?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I had mentioned earlier that three in four of the appeals are successful.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As to the suggestion, as I mentioned, we do regularly review the income criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We note that things have evolved and changed, post pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And so, we will take into account the suggestions and the inputs that the Member has given in our constant review in this matter.
